task_completion.description: Agent identifies the list of active cameras in the system (e.g., Parking Lot, Entrance, Server Room, Lobby, Loading Dock).
task_completion.visual_evidence: The camera resource tree or a list of devices is visible on the left sidebar or main panel of the VMS interface.

task_completion.description: Agent captures or saves a snapshot for each active camera found in the system.

integrity.description: The agent used the VMS graphical interface rather than executing CLI scripts to extract images.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the actual Nx Witness software elements.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply move existing files but generated them from the live camera feeds.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen opening each camera feed or selecting the snapshot option within the VMS interface before the files appear in the folder.
